mapper.select: SELECT id, book_id AS bookId, chapter_num AS chapterNum, chapter_name AS chapterName, word_count AS wordCount, update_time AS updateTime, create_time AS createTime FROM book_chapter WHERE book_id = #{bookId} ORDER BY chapter_num ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT bc.id AS chapter_id, bc.book_id AS chapter_book_id, bc.chapter_num AS chapter_num, bc.chapter_name AS chapter_name, bc.word_count AS chapter_word_count, bc.update_time AS chapter_update_time, bc.create_time AS chapter_create_time, bct.content AS content, bi.id AS book_id, bi.book_name AS book_name, bi.author_name AS book_author_name FROM book_chapter bc JOIN book_content bct ON bct.chapter_id = bc.id JOIN book_info bi ON bi.id = bc.book_id WHERE bc.id = #{chapterId} AND bi.status = 0
SELECT id FROM book_chapter WHERE book_id = #{bookId} AND chapter_num = #{chapterNum} - 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM book_chapter WHERE book_id = #{bookId} AND chapter_num = #{chapterNum} + 1 LIMIT 1
